architecture.principle: Complex modeling is controller-led and iterative. Each pass is a separate structured request. The controller reviews returned evidence between passes and authors the next refinement payload. The local operator does not autonomously redesign geometry.
architecture.key_constraint: operator_recommendation_scope = evidence_only in every pass-evaluation packet

transitions.trigger: accept result OR author next payload + commit new request

pass_1.focus: Primary proportions, topology, major solids, coarse dimensions

pass_2.focus: Controller-selected bounded discrepancy corrections from pass 1 evidence

pass_3.focus: Secondary geometry, cleanup, dimensional QA, artifact finalization

default_three_pass_strategy.note: Three passes are a useful default, not a hard limit. Extra or skipped passes are valid.

role_boundaries.controller: Authors every modeling/refinement payload. Reviews evidence between passes. Selects correction targets. Accepts result.
role_boundaries.claude_operator: Executes exact payload. Measures, validates, captures, saves. Reports objective evidence. Does not redesign. Does not author next pass.
role_boundaries.codex_operator: Same default as Claude. May author modeling code only when active request contains explicit local_modeling_authorized=true.
role_boundaries.reviewer: Verifies modeling_run_id consistency, pass_index sequencing, parent references, executed SHA, and absence of unauthorized local modeling.

pass_lineage_fields.modeling_run_id: Stable ID linking all passes of one model build. Controller assigns.
pass_lineage_fields.requires_controller_review_after: True when pass must be reviewed before continuing.

backward_compatibility.single_pass_payloads: Multi-pass fields are all optional. Existing single-pass manifests (including _example) remain valid — run_rhino_payload.py does not check for these fields.
backward_compatibility.run_rhino_payload_py: Unchanged. No new dependencies on multi-pass fields.
backward_compatibility.protocol_version: 0.3 unchanged. multi_pass_modeling block added as additive field.
